prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one 74x100 target-scale dialogue portrait for a gritty low-fantasy RPG. This is a substantive redraw of this one established character, not a collage or a crop of the old art.
References: image 1 supplies ONLY this character identity and clothing. Images 2-5 are the four approved pixel portrait STYLE cores (Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore); do not copy their face or their expression.
Composition is critical: one very large adult face in a tall portrait frame, 3/4 turn slightly toward viewer left. Complete top hair/head-covering, both visible-side silhouette and ear contained with a tiny transparent margin; head and face occupy almost all the canvas. Crown around y=3%, chin/beard bottom around y=88%; only a very short neck and narrow collar in the bottom 10%. No shoulders spread, chest, hands, props, book, torso, frame, backdrop, letters, number, or other character. Do not let a broad headscarf force the face to be small.
Style: genuinely hard-edged large pixel CLUSTERS throughout, native-size-style shapes resolved for 74x100 readability. Big connected nose bridge, cheekbone, temple, eyelid and jaw planes. Restrained warm ochre skin planes and deep reddish-brown shadows, near-black outline accents. Limited approximately 24-32 flat opaque colors. No dithering, noise, fine scattered hair, painterly rendering, gradients, photographic detail, antialiasing, blurry edges, glossy skin or tiny speckles. Eyes small and dark, tiny muted whites only, no luminous bright white stripes. Keep individual adult face shape, not chibi, anime, cute giant eyes, or generic anguished eyebrows. Transparent background, binary-looking clean alpha silhouette.
Identity: RENA VIER, female rental-record clerk in her mid-forties. Mature long-oval face, modest broad nose and visible cheek planes, subtle age at eyes and mouth, brown hair with broad side-parted locks tucked under her plain cream linen headscarf. Preserve the off-white headscarf as a close-fitting modest wrap with compact knot at the back, not a hood, bonnet, huge bow or veil; complete wrap visible. Dark forest-green clerk overgown with a narrow off-white stiff collar appears only as a small base. She has a quiet conscientious but guarded expression: eyes glance slightly downward-left, closed lightly pressed mouth, subtle inner brow concern without exaggerated sorrow. Age must read forties, not child or youthful maid. She is a responsible imperfect worker, not an icy official. No earrings, badge, jewellery or cosmetics.
Deliver exactly one clean standalone portrait, tightly framed at the intended 74:100 ratio, background truly transparent.
